title: ANS known registries
description: Directory of public ANS registries (a Registration Authority and its Transparency Log, per environment) that consumers can choose from. Being listed is not an endorsement and does not make a registry trusted; see registries/README.md.

id.description: Stable identifier for the registry, never reused. Convention: the operator's name in lower case.

operator.description: Display name of the organization that runs the registry.

documentation.description: The operator's setup documentation for registrants and verifiers.

environments.description: The environments the operator runs. Nothing registered in test is production state.

ra.description: Registration Authority origin. ANS-1 routes are served under it.

tl.description: Transparency Log origin. /checkpoint, /root-keys, and the ANS-4 read routes are served under it.

identityCa.description: Where the operator publishes the CA bundle that issues this environment's identity certificates. Informational: fetching the bundle does not make its roots trusted.

url.description: The published PEM bundle. URLs into this repository use the main ref, e.g. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/agentnameservice/ans-spec/main/pki/prod/ca-bundle.pem.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bundle bytes, lower-case hex.
